## Problem And Change

Describe the workflow or source pattern, and what changes for the user.

## Evidence

Provide a redistributable example and the expected graph relationships or output.
List checks actually run and any checks not run. Do not equate compilation with
functional verification.

## Compatibility

Describe API/CLI/MCP, database, configuration, dependency, or release implications.
State whether migration or re-indexing is needed.

## Publication Hygiene

Confirm that the diff contains no credentials, private customer source/data, or
generated binaries. Identify the provenance of any third-party source excerpts.
